description: Working-tree status as typed rows: branch, upstream, ahead/behind, and one entry per changed path. Fails when the root is not a repository — that is an absent overlay, not a broken workspace.

cwd.description: Directory to run git in. Defaults to the workspace root. Confined by shell's jail exactly like any other `shell::exec` call.

StatusEntry.description: A single changed path as git sees it.

index.description: Status of the staged copy: `modified`, `added`, `deleted`, `renamed`, `copied`, `untracked`, `ignored`, `conflicted`, or `unchanged`.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

renamed_from.description: Original path for a rename or copy.

staged.description: True when the staged copy differs from HEAD.

worktree.description: Status of the working-tree copy, same vocabulary as `index`.

response_schema.description: Branch header plus every changed path.

ahead.description: Commits on this branch the upstream does not have.

behind.description: Commits on the upstream this branch does not have.

branch.description: Current branch, or `None` on a detached HEAD.

clean.description: True when nothing is modified, staged, or untracked.

entries.description: One row per changed path, in git's order.

response_schema.title: StatusReport
